Hi Priya,

It was great to meet with you on September 8, and I'm sorry these notes took a week to reach you. Here they are, roughly in order of importance:

  - Early to mid September: firm info sessions and coffee chats

Dear all,

A reminder that UK clocks go back one hour at 02:00 on Sunday 25 October, so you get an extra hour in bed.

Please be careful with anything you have scheduled with people in the US. Their clocks don't change until Sunday 1 November, so for that one week (26 to 31 October) London is only four hours ahead of the East Coast and seven hours ahead of the West Coast, instead of the usual five and eight. Every year someone misses an interview because of this, so please check your calendars now.

Clocks in most of mainland Europe change on the same weekend as ours, so calls home should be unaffected.

Best wishes,
Fiona
